meta.title: VIETNAMESE ECO COOKING CLASS + COCONUT BOATS | Hoi An
meta.description:
Today we took part in something we have wanted to do since we landed in Vietnam. A COOKING CLASS!! An easy way to our hearts is through food and it's one of the best ways (in our opinion) to explore a new culture. This tour included a visit to the market, a cooking class, and a trip down the canals of Hoi An on the famous coconut boat.

This was an absolute bucket list type day. Hoi An is know for having many delicious dishes that are specific to this region so when we decided we wanted to do a Vietnamese cooking class we knew it had to be here! Hope you enjoy the video:)

Please LIKE + SUBSCRIBE to follow along for more of our Vietnam adventures! 

Big thanks again to Hoi An Cooking School for this experience!! If you find yourself in Hoi An and want to try out this AMAZING cooking class then check out the links below 😁
